$comment: The de-marking template set. THIS FILE IS THE MANIPULATION.
D2, D3, and D4 insert language rather than only removing structure, so the
inserted wording is fixed here and applied uniformly to every specimen.
A sentence hand-written for one specimen is how an implicit arm becomes a
strawman without anyone intending it.
Templates must be GENEROUS, not stingy. The manipulation is HOW a relation is
encoded, never WHETHER it is encoded. A template that drops force rather than
restating it in ordinary words violates propositional equivalence and would
make any measured gap an artifact of the template rather than of marking.
frozen=false until L2. Set frozen=true in the instrument-lock commit.
After that, any change is an amendment.

d1_sequence.$comment: Steps component -> prose. Order preserved in sentence sequence.
d1_sequence.lead_in: Complete the following steps in order.

d2_membership.$comment: Tabs -> prose enumeration. lead_in states the alternatives relation in words exactly once, which is the relational content the tabs carried structurally.
d2_membership.lead_in: Choose one of the following options. These are alternatives — use exactly one, not all of them.

d3_force_aside.$comment: Asides -> inline prose, in place. Each phrase must carry the same force the admonition type carried, in ordinary words.

$comment: RFC 2119/8174 keywords -> ordinary modals. Keys are matched only as whole
words in ALL CAPS, per RFC 8174: a lowercase 'must' is already ordinary
English. Longer keys are matched first, so MUST NOT never becomes MUST.
The mapping lowercases and does nothing else. See ADR-0001 (decisions/).
Capitalization IS the marking, per RFC 8174, so removing it is the whole
de-marking — exactly, minimally, nothing else disturbed. The design's earlier
illustration ('MUST' -> 'needs to') was rejected: applied mechanically it is
ungrammatical for the corpus's most common construction ('You MUST restart'
-> 'You needs to restart'), and broken grammar in the implicit arm ONLY makes
the arms distinguishable on fluency rather than on marking.
Consequence, pre-specified: D4 is the smallest manipulation in the set and
its instances are reported separately from D3 within R3, never pooled.

d7_precondition_table.$comment: Tables -> prose enumeration, in place. One sentence per body row, field names taken from the header row.
d7_precondition_table.lead_in: The table below is given as a list.

$comment: Prerequisite-heading blocks -> heading removed, content in place, template sentence asserts the precondition.
heading_patterns lists regex patterns for headings to unmark (case-insensitive).
The lead_in replaces the heading line entirely.
d8_prerequisite_heading.lead_in: Before you begin, you need the following:
